name: Aggregates::merge

test_list.description: Merging the aggregates of two event slices gives the same snapshot as aggregating the concatenated slice.
Merging an empty aggregate (either side) changes nothing.
Merging two aggregates whose counters sum above u64::MAX pins the counter and sets saturated.
Models present on one side are kept, models on both sides are summed.
proptest: for random event streams split at a random point, merge(a, b) equals aggregating the whole stream.
proptest: merge(a, b) and merge(b, a) give identical snapshots.

inputs.name: other
inputs.description: The aggregate to add into self.

output_description: Adds every counter (saturating), the per-model table and the latency histograms of other into self.
